sourceBoundaries.finding: Current entry always creates WebPlatformAdapter; controlled boolean recognizes only pwa. Public path mounts canonical auth/CMS/analytics/community; controlled path mounts signed Web session gate. Native entry must select an explicit controlled native target, use the same App, and omit public remote integrations/PWA service worker/Web license bootstrap. Do not copy dist-pwa as a native product.

Existing stable PlatformServices supports Android/iOS kinds and channels, preferences, visibility/connectivity, explicit external links. Provider rejects replacement. Add narrow inbound host-event/bootstrap contracts; canonical country/writer/work/camera/child state stays outside adapters.

Initial language uses localStorage, route dataset and only PWA navigator preferences. Native App.getAppLanguage is asynchronous. Await initialization, then pass an explicit validated initial language/persistence port into this same provider; preserve its canonical control and no locale keys. Native preference errors must not silently certify durable persistence.

App reads useAuth. Native accountless context must explicitly remain unconfigured/read-only without starting Supabase transport. The existing default context is loading:true, so merely omitting AuthProvider should not be treated as a fully designed accountless state.

Default source root is src; native SDK imports only under src/platform/adapters/android or ios, never web-reachable. Root capacitor.config.* is audited; nested config is not implicit. Put platform entries in adapter roots and shared host UI in an SDK-free root, or extend explicit audited roots. --entry denotes WEB entry, so do not pass a native entry there. Preserve remote-runtime prohibition and web graph checks.

guardrails: Local compiled webDir only; no server.url, remote allowNavigation, updater, downloaded executable WebView runtime or generated duplicate globe/catalog.
Only public journal links open through an allowlisted external system action; no SDK import or remote runtime in the canonical web graph.

Native bootstrap snapshots async OS language before mounting; locale changes within the live process preserve WebView/React/Canvas identity. Process kill or OS-forced restart can restore semantic state, not the same destroyed renderer object.
Restore mode before the first content frame. Unknown child policy fails closed. Full child catalog, PIN/age assurance and policy engine remain mapped later work, not a fake implemented child mode.
Preferences are non-secret and cannot prove paid entitlement. Durable secure storage and native purchase/verification ports must not use paid=true or copied Web account tokens.
Critical RU/EN native/bootstrap copy remains explicitly draft until actual review. No English fallback certification or native screenshots from browser mocks.
Explicit includePlugins/variant dependencies and final binary audit prevent accidental cross-store SDKs or permission expansion. Global HTTP/cookie monkeypatches stay off unless separately justified.
Reuse canonical brand tokens/assets and no editable duplicate source database. Changes to protected UI/scene require existing owner-lock test evidence, not invented owner attestations.

officialSources.facts: Official Latest stable 8.5.1, released 2026-08-31; tag points to 0c9e35d. Release includes internal HTTP proxy navigation and listener-removal fixes. Peripheral GitHub assets loading errors did not prevent reading release text.
Node >=22; iOS builds require macOS, Xcode >=26 and command line tools. SPM recommended; CocoaPods optional. Android Studio >=2025.2.1 and Android SDK required by documented development setup.
Versioned library source sets Java source/target21, AGP8.13.0, default compile/target API36 and minimum API24.
Versioned CLI is 8.5.1 and declares Node>=22.

Cap8 deployment target iOS15; SPM default. Android density configChanges avoids WebView reload on resize. Edge-to-edge uses SystemBars/CSS insets instead of removed adjustMarginsForEdgeToEdge. Kotlin2.2.20 if used.

Cap8.5 adopts UIScene on iOS. New SceneDelegate forwards lifecycle/deep links through SceneDelegateProxy; test cold/warm links and pause/resume. Existing custom AppDelegate handlers need the scene path. This is not evidence of a current App Store Xcode27 deadline.

webDir contains compiled local assets and index.html. server.url, external allowNavigation and cleartext are documented development settings; project policy forbids remote runtime. Explicit includePlugins limits plugin discovery. Keep global Http/Cookies patches disabled by default; released logs must not expose secrets.

App exposes cold launch URL, warm URL events, lifecycle and Android back handling. getAppLanguage() is asynchronous, app-specific, since8.1.0. Listener handles require individual cleanup; do not remove other subscribers.
Capacitor sync manages generated CapApp-SPM dependency configuration. Keep local custom settings outside generated dependency lists where possible.
